Original successful first table lookup or expansion leaves the requested index within the bounds; no intervening callback changes them before the second bounds check. This second expansion requires the first expansion to fail, but original 0x4db6e0 realloc-zero faults in 0x4dc680 before returning.

Original second-lookup failure arm cannot execute: reaching its expansion requires original first expansion failure, which faults through 0x4db6e0 -> 0x4dc680 after EBP is zeroed; independent second expansion failure has the same original null read.

equivalent_mutants.reason: Checked against original homeTick calls at 0x4596f3 and 0x4596fa and complete original callees 0x406150-0x406173 and 0x406180-0x4061a3: 0x406150 conditionally negates and exchanges only sprite fields +0x128/+0x130; 0x406180 independently does the same only to +0x138/+0x140. Both take the same unchanged receiver, return no consumed value, and contain no calls or accesses outside their respective disjoint field pairs. Their conditions read only their own pair, so exchanging these adjacent calls preserves all memory and observable events for every completing input.
